description: Angular component for configuring transformation scripts in the Thingsboard platform, including form handling, script validation, and testing functionalities.

classes.name: TransformScriptConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing script configuration in rule nodes, supporting JavaScript and Tbel scripts, with validation and testing features.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for script configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns form fields that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates validators based on script language and enabled features.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and defaults configuration before use.

methods.name: testScript
methods.description: Tests the current script and updates the form with the result.

methods.name: onValidate
methods.description: Performs validation, especially for JavaScript scripts.
